notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jan Jansen.
You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Construct, adding {C}{C}.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the remaining Construct.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jensen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
